capabilities: browse dates in month and year views with lunar dates, solar terms, holidays and swap days
create daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly periodic notes by double-clicking calendar cells
apply templates from Obsidian core Templates or Templater when creating periodic notes
annotate calendar days with word-count and open-task indicators from linked notes
adjust font size and quarter naming in settings
extras: README is in Chinese and does not include screenshots; periodic notes and template integration must be enabled and configured (template path, which template plugin) in settings before use.
motivation: The README states it is designed to be a calendar plugin more suited to Chinese habits (更符合中国习惯).
problem: Calendar views in Obsidian show only Gregorian dates, so users who need lunar dates, solar terms, or Chinese holidays and调休 information have no built-in way to see them alongside their notes.

relations.evidence: Dust Calendar 支持 Obsidian 核心插件中的模板和 Templater

summary: Calendar plugin for Chinese conventions that shows lunar dates, solar terms, holidays and swap days, and creates periodic notes.
